title: Getting started
text: Parquet columnar storage file format optimised analytical workloads. Compared SAS files (row-based formats like CSV), Parquet offers: Smaller file size: Efficient compression significantly reduces disk space, especially large datasets. Faster queries: columnar layout speeds analytical queries need subset columns. Wide tool support: Parquet supported across data processing frameworks R, Python, beyond, making easy integrate modern workflows.

title: Fast Conversion and Querying of Danish Registers with Parquet
text: fastreg converts large SAS register files (.sas7bdat) Apache Parquet format. particularly useful researchers working Danish registers Statistics Denmark, large SAS files common. Parquet files smaller disk, faster read, work well modern tools like DuckDB Arrow. register context refers collection related data files, typically yearly snapshots like bef2020.sas7bdat, bef2021.sas7bdat (BEF register). fastreg provides functions : Convert SAS files Parquet. Read Parquet registers. Create targets pipeline template parallel conversion. List SAS Parquet files directories.

title: Fast Conversion and Querying of Danish Registers with Parquet
